check_box.name: diopter_enabled
check_box.label: Enable Ultimate Diopter
check_box.tool_tip: Master switch. When off the effect allocates no render targets and adds no draw calls.

combo_box.name: diopter_tool_mode
combo_box.label: Tool Mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Switches the post pass between the Ultimate Diopter (lens-front glass/halo) and the Ultimate Kaleidoscope (fold patterns). Both share this floater's master enable and render target; only one runs at a time.

combo_box.name: diopter_preset
combo_box.label: Preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Sets the optical character. Framing (position, size, focus, angle) stays on your sliders.

combo_box.name: diopter_placement
combo_box.label: Placement
combo_box.tool_tip: Framed: a placed glass element with a visible boundary. On-lens: the whole frame sits behind the filter and the center only sets the optical axis. In on-lens mode the Size slider and Contents combo are inert; size-targeted motion (Pulse: Size, Stutter Size) breathes the falloff reach instead.

button.name: diopter_pick_base
button.tool_tip: Pick the subject in-world to set Base Distance

combo_box.name: diopter_base_range
combo_box.label: Range
combo_box.tool_tip: Narrows Base Distance's slider span for finer control at this scale (§5.3e). Auto-picked on open and after every eyedropper pick.

button.label: Set From Camera Focus
button.name: diopter_set_from_camera
button.tool_tip: Writes Base Distance from wherever the camera is currently focused (§5.3b) -- same target the eyedropper's readout shows.

check_box.name: diopter_show_depth
check_box.label: Show Depth (Setup View)
check_box.tool_tip: Toggles the Main tab's Setup View between Off and Depth (§5.3c) -- calibrating a depth value while looking at the depth map is a different experience from doing it blind.

check_box.name: diopter_focus_crosshair
check_box.label: Show Focus Point Marker
check_box.tool_tip: Draws a crosshair at the camera's resolved focus point in-world (§5.3d).

check_box.name: diopter_focus_locked
check_box.label: Lock Focus Point To Subject
check_box.tool_tip: Keeps the focus point marker anchored to the last resolved subject (§5.3d).

button.name: diopter_pick_lens
button.tool_tip: Pick the subject in-world to set Lens Distance

combo_box.name: diopter_lens_range
combo_box.label: Range
combo_box.tool_tip: Narrows Lens Distance's slider span for finer control at this scale (§5.3e).

combo_box.name: kal_preset
combo_box.label: Preset
combo_box.tool_tip: Sets the fold pattern and motion character. Framing (center, protect center), Blend, Setup View and Freeze stay on your sliders.

slider.name: kal_seam_soften
slider.label: Seam Soften
slider.tool_tip: Feathers the mirror seams (Radial Mirror pattern only).

combo_box.name: kal_protect_mode
combo_box.label: Protect Mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Holds the untouched subject over the kaleidoscope.

button.name: kal_pick_depth_cut
button.tool_tip: Pick the subject in-world to set Depth Cut and arm Depth protection

combo_box.name: kal_depth_cut_range
combo_box.label: Range
combo_box.tool_tip: Narrows Depth Cut's slider span for finer control at this scale (§5.3e). Auto-picked on open and after every eyedropper pick.

check_box.name: kal_show_depth
check_box.label: Show Depth (Setup View)
check_box.tool_tip: Toggles the Main tab's Setup View between Off and Depth (§5.3c); calibrating Depth Cut while looking at the depth map is a different experience from doing it blind.

combo_box.name: kal_depth_feather_range
combo_box.label: Range
combo_box.tool_tip: Narrows Depth Feather's slider span for finer control at this scale (§5.3e).

check_box.name: diopter_active_only
check_box.label: Active controls only
check_box.tool_tip: Off shows every control that belongs to the current mode, including inactive ones, all dimmed with an explanation. It does not restore the old flat layout -- moved controls stay where the new tabs put them.
